items.snippet: KiiiKiii, a rookie girl group under Starship Entertainment, home to Ive, has been steadily building momentum with each release, most recently with its third EP "WhyKiiiKiii," which...
items.description: KiiiKiii, a rookie girl group under Starship Entertainment, home to Ive, has been steadily building momentum with each release, most recently with its third EP "WhyKiiiKiii," which dropped Monday. The EP's main track "Pop Off Pop Off" topped YouTube's worldwide trending music video chart shortly after release and had peaked at No. 27 on Melon's Top 100 as of Tuesday. The album also topped iTunes' K-pop albums chart in France, the Netherlands and Australia, and entered the top 10 in 13 countries.

items.description: Doh Kyung-soo, also known as Exo's D.O., will launch a 10-city Asia solo tour titled “Day Off” in Seoul in October, agency Blitzway Music said Tuesday. He is set to kick off the concert tour with a three-day run in Seoul from Oct. 2-4, ten months after his second Asia tour. Tour stops for the remainder of this year are Macao, Bangkok, Jakarta and Kaohsiung. After a break, he will perform in Singapore, Hong Kong, Manila and Tokyo before wrapping it up in Taipei in March.
